name: Hire LA's Youth
org: City of Los Angeles Community Investment Department (CID), formerly EWDD
what_you_do: Get a starter job with work-skills training, career coaching and money lessons. One sub-program puts high school students to work helping elementary kids in LA's BEST after-school programs.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 24 living in the City of Los Angeles. The checklist PDF (2024 version) lists the other rules on who can join. Check the current one.
pay_detail: Paid. The home page says Student to Student Success pays minimum wage for training and work hours. It gives no rate for the other jobs.
duration: Varies. Student to Student Success is up to 140 hours in one school semester (20 hours of training, up to 120 hours of service).
deadline_text: The site banner says it is accepting applications but gives no dates, and its document library page still shows a 2022 summer banner. Call the city at 213-744-7300, the old EWDD number, to confirm the current cycle.
how_to_apply: Create an application on the Hire LA site, then bring or upload proof of age, right-to-work (I-9) documents, City of LA residency and the family income form.
notes: Cycle dates are not confirmed, so check with the city before you count on a summer 2027 spot. The home page and the city Youth Services page both say ages 14 to 24. EWDD became part of the Community Investment Department, which runs 14 free YouthSource Centers for ages 14 to 24. They offer school help, job readiness and some paid internships. Ask at your nearest center, for example Boyle Heights 323-526-5800 or South LA 323-903-6926. Under 18 you need a California work permit. See permit.html?state=ca for the exact permit and steps. Checked 2026-10-26: the home page still says "Accepting applications for" with no year or dates, so left unconfirmed.
